title: In-Context Batch Black-box Optimization via Flow Matching
abstract: arXiv:2610.20138v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Batch black-box optimization is important for expensive systems where many candidates can be evaluated in parallel, yet only a few rounds of evaluation are affordable. In this regime, effective batch construction must identify multiple promising regions while avoiding redundant evaluations, and conventional Bayesian optimization can require increasingly difficult batch-selection procedures as the batch size grows. We introduce Flow Matching for Thompson-Sampling Refinement (FMTR), an amortized approach that learns offline a continuous, history-conditioned proposal distribution from which variable-size batches can be sampled. FMTR is trained offline by conditional flow matching on Thompson-sampling argmaxes refined toward high-value regions via a horizon-dependent Langevin pushforward map, adapting the exploration-exploitation tradeoff over the optimization horizon. translated_title: 基于流匹配的上下文批量黑盒优化
translated_abstract: 批量黑盒优化对于昂贵系统非常重要，在这类系统中可以并行评估多个候选方案，但只能负担少数几轮评估。在这种情况下，有效的批量构建必须在识别多个有前景区域的同时避免冗余评估，而传统贝叶斯优化随着批量大小的增长，可能需要越来越复杂的批量选择程序。我们提出了汤普森采样精炼流匹配（FMTR），这是一种摊销方法，可以离线学习一个连续的、以历史为条件的提议分布，从中可以采样可变大小的批量。FMTR通过条件流匹配在汤普森采样的argmax上进行离线训练，这些argmax通过一个依赖于优化视野的朗之万前推映射向高价值区域精炼，从而在优化过程中自适应地调整探索-利用权衡。在测试时，模型参数保持固定，批量生成只需（原文在此截断）。
tldr: 提出FMTR方法，利用流匹配离线学习历史条件化的连续提议分布，实现可变大小批量的高效采样，并在优化过程中自适应平衡探索与利用，改进批量黑盒优化。
en_tdlr: FMTR is an amortized batch black-box optimization approach that uses conditional flow matching to learn a history-conditioned proposal distribution offline, enabling efficient variable-size batch sampling that adaptively balances exploration and exploitation.
